names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 6 aprilie, «Sfânta Cuvioasă Platonida».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 6 Απριλίου, «Οσία Πλατωνίς», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind her line for 6 апреля ст. ст., name page 2646, «Платонида Сирская, прп.», with the rank abbreviation left off. The day’s own line gives «Платониды Сирской» in the genitive, with the same toponymic, which is the one neither doxologia nor saint.gr printed. No folder holds this form and none holds the bare «Платонида», although the corpus keeps two other Platonidas.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Платониды Сирской (308).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 aprilie — «Sfânta Cuvioasă Platonida»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Απριλίου — «Οσία Πλατωνίς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads her «(; - 308)». It closes with an alternative account of her end which it does not decide between: «Κατα άλλους, η Οσία Πλατωνίς μαρτύρησε μαζί με δυο άλλους Χριστιανούς στον Ασκάλωνα της Παλαιστίνης» — according to others she was martyred with two other Christians at Ascalon in Palestine. The same day page lists two unnamed martyrs of Ascalon as a separate entry, and the page does not say the three are one company. No dates are recorded from the 308 in the heading, which the page's own prose does not repeat.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

death.note: The first date this folder has carried. days.pravoslavie.ru closes her line for 6 апреля ст. ст. with «(308)» and its life ends «Достигнув глубокой старости, преподобная Платонида мирно скончалась в 308 году». doxologia.ro and saint.gr, the two books the folder was made from, print no year, no reign and no century for her at all. The deep old age is not turned into a year of birth, an age being not a year.
